select fished_date_season season, cls, count(*) n, sum(yt) yt_sum, sum(anglers) ang_sum,
  round(sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0),3) yt_per_ang
from trips
where fished_date_season=2
group by season, cls
order by yt_per_ang desc

select ts_season season, cast(ts_doy/10 as int)*10 as doy_bucket, round(avg(wtmp_c),2) avg_pier_c, count(*) n
from pier
where ts_doy between 0 and 65
group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select ts_season season, cast(ts_doy/5 as int)*5 as doy_bucket, round(avg(wtmp_c),2) avg_pier_c
from pier
where ts_doy between 70 and 130 and ts_season=1
group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select fished_date_season season, cast(fished_date_doy/5 as int)*5 as doy_bucket, cls,
  sum(yt) yt_sum, sum(anglers) ang_sum, round(sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0),3) yt_per_ang
from trips
where fished_date_doy between 70 and 130 and fished_date_season=1 and cls in ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
group by 1,2,3 order by 2,3

select index_id, avail_season, avail_doy, value from climate
where avail_season=2 order by avail_doy desc limit 12

select report_date_doy, wt_all, yt_all, text from fishdope
where report_date_season=2 and report_date_doy between 45 and 60
order by report_date_doy desc limit 8

select ts_season season, cast(ts_doy/5 as int)*5 doy_bucket, round(avg(wtmp_c),2) avg_c
from pier where ts_season=2 and ts_doy between 55 and 65
group by 1,2 order by 2
